archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Tailored for Calm, Practical, Local Credibility)
brand_tone: calm, practical, credible, local, professional safety report

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#102133] (or text-white on Navy)
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#102133]

navigation.style: bg-white border-b border-[#D9E2EC] sticky top-0 z-50

hero.headline: If OSHA walked in tomorrow, would you pass?
hero.cta: Take the 90-Second Safety Check (bg-[#1F6FEB] hover:bg-[#1558C0] text-white font-semibold px-8 py-4 rounded-lg)
hero.credentials: Text below CTA: e.g., 'Trusted by 50+ Kernersville/Triad NC manufacturers'

service_area.content: Local safety consulting for small manufacturers, warehouses, contractors in Kernersville/Triad NC.

service_cards.style: bg-white border border-[#D9E2EC] rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

free_check_callout.style: bg-[#F7F9FC] border-l-4 border-[#2A9D8F] p-6 rounded-r-lg shadow-sm
free_check_callout.contrast_note: Visually distinct from paid tiers using the accent teal.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1F6FEB] hover:bg-[#1558C0] text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#102133] border border-[#D9E2EC] hover:bg-[#F7F9FC] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

animations.hover_states: subtle background color shifts and slight shadow increases
animations.restrictions: No flashy animations or busy patterns. Keep it calm and practical.

icons.style: Stroke width 2, stroke-current, precise and technical

images.description: Industrial warehouse setting. Use with heavy #0B1F33 overlay (e.g. bg-[#0B1F33]/80) to ensure text legibility.
Worker in high-visibility vest operating machinery. Professional and safe.

images.placement: Services supporting image or Field Notes fallback

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on #0B1F33, #1F6FEB, and #2A9D8F meets WCAG AA standards. Text on #F7F9FC must use #102133 or #5B6B7A.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the exact color hex codes provided in the colors section. Do not use Tailwind default colors (e.g., blue-600) for primary elements, use the hex codes.
Apply the styling rules only to public pages. Portal pages (/intake, etc.) should not be modified to keep their existing dark brand.
Do not build a dark mode toggle. The marketing site is exclusively light mode (with Navy block sections for contrast).
Keep the phone number visible and sticky in the header. Make it a clickable tel: link on mobile.
Use standard HTML + Tailwind for marketing layout structure. Do not over-rely on Shadcn Card if it restricts the pricing table design.
Include a single primary CTA above the fold in the Hero section.
Ensure 'Take the 90-Second Safety Check' is visually prioritized over paid service CTAs using size and prominent #1F6FEB color.
